ui.reset.title: 初始化 Cheat Program
Initialize Cheat Program
ui.reset.scope: 将本客户端的用户数据文件夹整体移至 Windows 回收站。
Move this client's entire user-data folder to the Windows Recycle Bin.
ui.reset.contains: 包含配置、按键、好友、API Key、AI 玩家、粒子方案、建筑副本、聊天记录、已复制的素材及本地语音环境。
Includes profiles, bindings, friends, API keys, AI players, particle plans, saved buildings, chat history, copied assets and the local voice environment.
ui.reset.preserve: 只处理上方 Cheat Program 文件夹；游戏存档、其他模组、外部原始图片／视频／字体和你导出的外部文件保持不变。
Only the Cheat Program folder shown above is processed. Worlds, other mods, original external images/videos/fonts and files you exported elsewhere are preserved.
ui.reset.restartHint: 初始化后，本次会话停止运行本客户端功能及保存设置。重新启动 Minecraft 后，按首次使用的默认状态重新开始。
After initialization, this client's features and settings saves stop for the current session. Restart Minecraft to begin again with first-run defaults.
ui.reset.recycleHint: 文件仍可从回收站恢复。如果要彻底清除，请在确认不再需要后自行清空回收站。
Files remain recoverable from the Recycle Bin. To remove them permanently, empty the Recycle Bin yourself after confirming they are no longer needed.
ui.reset.acknowledge: 我已了解初始化范围和需要重启
I understand the scope and the required restart
ui.reset.validating: 正在检查客户端文件夹…
ui.reset.stopping: 正在停止功能和本地后台任务…
Stopping features and local background tasks…
ui.reset.recycling: 正在移至 Windows 回收站…
Moving to the Windows Recycle Bin…
ui.reset.complete: 客户端用户数据已移至回收站。
Client user data has been moved to the Recycle Bin.
ui.reset.restartReminder: 请保存世界并重新启动 Minecraft。旧设置不会在退出时重新写回；需要彻底清除时，请再清空回收站。
Save your world and restart Minecraft. Old settings will not be written back on exit. Empty the Recycle Bin separately if you want permanent removal.
ui.reset.windowsOnly: 此初始化方式需要 Windows 回收站，当前平台未执行任何文件操作。
This initialization method requires the Windows Recycle Bin. No file operation was performed on this platform.
ui.reset.invalidPath: 客户端文件夹路径或链接检查未通过，未移走该文件夹。
The client-folder path or link check failed; the folder was not moved.
ui.reset.recycleFailed: 未能完成回收站操作。请重新启动后检查客户端文件夹和回收站；本次会话不会重新保存旧设置。
The Recycle Bin operation could not be completed. Restart and check the client folder and Recycle Bin; this session will not save old settings again.
